full_judgment: 7. The learned Judge of the High Court Division in the Second Appeal by the plaintiffs, as already noticed, set aside the judgment and decree of the appellate court and restored those of the trial court upon finding that the appellate judgment was not a proper judgment of reversal in that the considerations which weighed with the learned Subordinate Judge could not be considered sufficient for reversing the findings of the learned Munsif and that the Judgment and decree of the trial court were reversed without controverting the reasons given by the learned Munsif in support of his conclusions.
